title: How shall I settle your heart? Triple fornication
english: [[How weak is your heart >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:30]] when you act the bold harlot — fornication threefold in spirit, soul, and body. You [[built your vault at every street head and paid your lovers >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:31-33]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Unlike a common harlot — you pay them
english: Unlike a hireling harlot, Jerusalem [[pays her lovers >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:33-34]] — pouring gifts on idols. Glory to God. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).
